items.source: For an actual concurrent startup, a bootstrap Executor needs to be set for the application context, typically through a "bootstrapExecutor" bean.
items.translation: 对于实际的并发启动，需要为应用程序上下文设置一个引导 `Executor`，通常通过“bootstrapExecutor”bean 来完成。

items.source:
In case of no specific timeout configured, the default timeout per
shutdown phase will apply: 10000 milliseconds (10 seconds) as of 6.2.
items.translation: 如果未配置特定的超时时间，将应用每个关闭阶段的默认超时时间：自 6.2 版本起为 10000 毫秒（10 秒）。

items.source: phasesWithTimeouts - a map of phase values (matching SmartLifecycle.getPhase()) and corresponding timeout values (in milliseconds)
items.translation: `phasesWithTimeouts` - 一个映射，将阶段值（匹配 SmartLifecycle.getPhase()）与相应的超时值（以毫秒为单位）对应起来。

items.source: phase - the phase value (matching SmartLifecycle.getPhase())
items.translation: phase - 阶段值（与SmartLifecycle.getPhase()匹配）

items.source: timeout - the corresponding timeout value (in milliseconds)
items.translation: timeout - 对应的超时值（以毫秒为单位）

items.source: Provides interaction with Lifecycle and SmartLifecycle beans in groups for specific phases, on startup/shutdown as well as for explicit start/stop interactions on a ConfigurableApplicationContext.
items.translation: 提供针对特定阶段，在启动/关闭期间以及针对 `ConfigurableApplicationContext` 的显式启动/停止交互时，与 `Lifecycle` 和 `SmartLifecycle` 组中的 Bean 进行交互。

items.source: As of 6.2, this processor can be configured with custom timeouts for specific shutdown phases, applied to SmartLifecycle.stop(Runnable) implementations. As of 6.2.6, there is also support for the concurrent startup of specific phases with individual timeouts, triggering the Lifecycle.start() callbacks of all associated beans asynchronously and then waiting for all of them to return, as an alternative to the default sequential startup of beans without a timeout.
items.translation: 自 6.2 版本起，该处理器可针对特定关闭阶段配置自定义超时时间，并应用于 `SmartLifecycle.stop(Runnable)` 实现。自 6.2.6 版本起，还支持为特定阶段并发启动并设置独立超时时间，从而异步触发所有关联 Bean 的 `Lifecycle.start()` 回调，然后等待它们全部返回；这提供了默认情况下无超时的顺序 Bean 启动的替代方案。

items.source: The default implementation checks for the Phased interface, using a default of 0 otherwise. Can be overridden to apply other/further policies.
items.translation: 默认实现会检查 `Phased` 接口，否则使用默认值 0。可以重写它以应用其他或进一步的策略。

items.source: As of 6.1, this also includes support for JVM checkpoint/restore (Project CRaC) when the org.crac:crac dependency is on the classpath. All running beans will get stopped and restarted according to the CRaC checkpoint/restore callbacks.
items.translation: 自 6.1 版本起，当类路径中包含 `org.crac:crac` 依赖时，还支持 JVM 检查点/恢复（Project CRaC）。所有正在运行的 Bean 将根据 CRaC 检查点/恢复回调进行停止和重启。

items.source: Note: By default, the startup for every phase will be sequential without a timeout. Calling this setter with timeouts for the given phases switches to a mode where the beans in these phases will be started concurrently, cancelling the startup if the corresponding timeout is not met for any of these phases.
items.translation: 注意：默认情况下，每个阶段的启动将按顺序进行且无超时限制。调用此 Setter 为给定阶段设置超时时间后，将切换到这些阶段的 Bean 并发启动的模式；如果任何阶段未能在对应超时时间内完成启动，则取消整个启动过程。

items.source: Note: By default, the startup for every phase will be sequential without a timeout. Calling this setter with a timeout for the given phase switches to a mode where the beans in this phase will be started concurrently, cancelling the startup if the corresponding timeout is not met for this phase.
items.translation: 注意：默认情况下，每个阶段的启动将按顺序进行且无超时。为给定阶段调用此 setter 并设置超时时间后，将切换到并发模式启动该阶段的 Bean；如果该阶段未在规定时间内完成启动，则取消启动。

items.source: The default value is 10000 milliseconds (10 seconds) as of 6.2.
items.translation: 默认值为 6.2 版本中的 10000 毫秒（10 秒）。

items.source: Start all registered beans that implement Lifecycle and are not already running. Any bean that implements SmartLifecycle will be started within its 'phase', and all phases will be ordered from lowest to highest value. All beans that do not implement SmartLifecycle will be started in the default phase 0. A bean declared as a dependency of another bean will be started before the dependent bean regardless of the declared phase.
items.translation: 启动所有已注册的实现了 Lifecycle 且尚未运行的 Bean。任何实现了 SmartLifecycle 的 Bean 都将在其指定的“阶段”内启动，并且所有阶段将按从低到高的值顺序排列。所有未实现 SmartLifecycle 的 Bean 都将在默认阶段 0 中启动。如果一个 Bean 被声明为另一个 Bean 的依赖项，则无论其声明的阶段如何，该依赖 Bean 都将被先启动。

items.source: Stop all registered beans that implement Lifecycle and are currently running. Any bean that implements SmartLifecycle will be stopped within its 'phase', and all phases will be ordered from highest to lowest value. All beans that do not implement SmartLifecycle will be stopped in the default phase 0. A bean declared as dependent on another bean will be stopped before the dependency bean regardless of the declared phase.
items.translation: 停止所有已注册的、实现了Lifecycle且当前正在运行的 Bean。任何实现了SmartLifecycle的 Bean 都将在其指定的“阶段”内停止，并且所有阶段将按从最高值到最低值的顺序排列。所有未实现SmartLifecycle的 Bean 都将在默认阶段 0 中停止。声明为依赖于另一个 Bean 的 Bean 将无论其声明的阶段如何，都在依赖 Bean 之前停止。

items.source: Start all registered beans that implement Lifecycle and are not already running.
items.translation: 启动所有已注册的实现了Lifecycle接口且尚未运行的bean。

items.source: Stop all registered beans that implement Lifecycle and are currently running.
items.translation: 停止所有已注册的、实现Lifecycle且当前正在运行的 Bean。

items.translation: 公共上下文检查点的属性名称："spring.context.checkpoint"。
